utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: yes buy us a bag of popcorn and two beverages please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: ok great i ordered those. Do you want me to reserve seating?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: no thats ok we can just find seating when we get there

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: ok great . i have two tickets to vice at 12:15 pm i prepaid for one large bag of popcorn and two beverages with non reserved seating.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: ok great what is my total?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: it looks like the total is going to be 45.50

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: ok great sounds perfect thank you

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: no problem. im going to be sending the confirmation to your mobile device via text message. is there anything else i can do for you?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: not right now thats all i needed thank you

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: no problem enjoy your movie

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hello Mark? I need two tickets for Aquaman please?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hello Chris, would you like those tickets for the closest theater to your location or another one?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'd like tickets for the Regal cinemas closest to my house.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok Chris, would you like the 7 pm showing, the 8:45 pm, or the 9 pm?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hold on, I need a minute.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, Chris.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Alright, I think I want the 7 pm showing.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, Chris. Just to confirm you want two tickets to Aquaman at 7 pm at the Regal Cinemas?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, Chris. How would you like to pay?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Use my debit card please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: The debit card starting in 0000?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that one.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, great. I am charging $19.50 to your Visa debit card starting in 0000.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok, thanks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Is that everything?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Actually, can you buy me one more ticket, same movie, same location and same time.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, I am charging $9.75 to your Visa debit starting in 0000 for an additional ticket to Aquaman at 7 pm at the Regal Cinemas.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Is that everything?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Actually can you change that to the 9:45 showing?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure, give me one moment.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No problem.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I was unable to change the tickets because the 9:45 is full.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: OK, can you check if the next showing is full?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure, one moment.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok, no problem.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: There are seats available at the 10 pm showing shall I switch them?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, I have changed your three tickets to Aquaman at 10 pm at the Regal Cinemas. Enjoy your show!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Can you help me find a movie to watch?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Of course! Are there any genres you'd prefer to watch?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'd like to watch something lighthearted, like a comedy.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK! Would you like to narrow it down more, or should I start making suggestions?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I want it to be an older movie, not something from the past ten years.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK! You're looking for an older comedy. Would you like to narrow it down more or should I make a suggestion?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Give me a suggestion.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You could watch Airplane! (1980).

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, I've watched Airplane! too recently.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: How many stars out of five would you rate Airplane! ?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Five Stars.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, would you like me to suggest another movie?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, suggest another movie.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You could watch The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad! (1988).

segments.text: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's a good choice, I'd like to watch that.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great! I hope you enjoy the movie.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You're welcome.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey, do you know any good movies lately?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh, there's been a few this year. What were you looking for?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I wanted something Adventurous, but with a lot of Action or Comedy.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Well, what have you seen so far?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I've seen all the Marvel and Disney movies that released this year.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Do you like espionage?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sure why not? Usually don't care much for deep plots in action movies though.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Are you a fan of Mission Impossible? Fallout came out a few months ago, and it was really good!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I have really liked most of the Mission Impossibles. The first was a classic!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I think you'd enjoy it. If not how bout something like The Incredibles? It's a really charming sequel.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I did really love the first Incredibles. Haven't gotten around to the second yet. Do you have anything darker?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh, I thought The Quiet Place was amazing! It's not quite in your category but if you like suspenseful things you would really love it.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I remember that got a lot of awards. What was it about?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Well I don't want to spoil too much, but it's about a family trying to survive in an apocalyptic kind of invasion of earth. It has a lot of twists.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I think that would be great.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Awesome, when you watch A Quiet Place you should definitely try to be immersed in it. Watch it someplace quiet.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need your help finding something to watch tonight.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I can certainly help with that. What are you in the mood for?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No comedies, please.Something serious.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: New or old?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Old, I guess if I haven't seen it before.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: How about something with an ensemble cast?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Do you have something in mind?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, the Big Chill.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, nothing with William Hurt in it.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh, okay. Do you want to see an action movie?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Violence is okay, but I don't want to see an action movie.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. You want an older, serious movie, with violence and an ensamble cast. How about McCabe and Mrs. Miller?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That would be good, but I just watched it a few weeks ago.Do you have another suggestion along those lines?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes I do. How about The Deer Hunter?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey, that ticks all my boxes! Perfect suggestion.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Thank you, sir. Shall I order it for you now?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yeah, you'd better. It's a real commitment to sit down and watch a movie that long, but it sure is good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'm playing it for you now. Let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I want o book a table in large 5 star hotel

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: sure sir!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Do u need the details?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes,how many tables I need to book?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Maximum 5 tables.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Nice to hear this from you.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Can You able to book flight tickets?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes sir.For what place?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Book 5 tickets for Thailand.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Fine sir.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Is there any new movie released?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I think so.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need some favor.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Anything for you...please proceed.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Book some horror movie tickets.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Tell me the timing.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Book tickets at tonight.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK sir.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you for your help.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Its my pleasure sir!......
